now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
now.text: Once Mike is free of Hydra, he works with Coulson's team again in the fight to rebuild S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Free of Hydra and fighting with May's team.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent on the team Mike fights beside once he is free of Hydra.

proposed.text: May backs Coulson's plan and joins the raid on Dr. List's Hydra base that frees Mike from his cell.

changes.evidence: The text sums up Mike's general return to Coulson's side (he left Hydra in S1 and was already working with Coulson by S2#16). In S2#19 (The Dirty Half Dozen) May votes for Coulson's mission, and she is on the team that storms List's Arctic base and frees Mike, who is being held there with Lincoln.
changes.source: https://marvelcinematicuniverse.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Anne_Weaver&prop=wikitext&format=json (Attack on Hydra: Gonzales, Morse and May vote for the mission); https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Agents_of_S.H.I.E.L.D._season_2&action=raw (ep 19: Coulson, May, Skye, Fitz, Simmons and Ward infiltrate the Hydra base)

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20
now.text: Bobbi Morse respects Kara Palamas from their missions together, but intelligence Bobbi passes to HYDRA while undercover leads to Kara's capture and brainwashing. Kara later teams up with Grant Ward to kidnap Bobbi.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Bobbi respects, whose capture Bobbi's intel causes.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The agent whose intel leads to Kara's capture, whom Kara later kidnaps.

proposed.text: Bobbi Morse shows Kara Palamas kindness at S.H.I.E.L.D., but Kara remembers what Bobbi did to her and, disguised as May, ambushes Bobbi on a quinjet so Grant Ward can take her.

changes.evidence: In S2#20 (Scars) Bobbi defends Kara to May, and Kara, wearing May's face, ambushes Bobbi on the quinjet, saying she now remembers an unspoken incident between them; Ward then ICERs Bobbi. Nothing shows the two respecting each other from 'missions together'. That Bobbi gave Kara's location to Hydra is only spelled out in S2#21, when Ward explains Bakshi told them and tortures Bobbi for it.

now.text: Bobbi Morse respects Kara Palamas from their missions together, but intelligence Bobbi passes to HYDRA while undercover leads to Kara's capture and brainwashing. Kara later teams up with Grant Ward to kidnap Bobbi.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Bobbi respects, whose capture Bobbi's intel causes.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The agent whose intel leads to Kara's capture, whom Kara later kidnaps.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Bobbi shows kindness to, who turns on her for Ward.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The agent Kara ambushes and helps Ward kidnap.

changes.evidence: Both card lines state that Bobbi's intel caused Kara's capture, which is first told in S2#21 (S.O.S. Part One: Ward explains Bakshi told them Bobbi knowingly turned Kara over to Hydra). Stage 1 at S2#21 already carries it.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20
now.text: Gonzales comes to the Inhumans' Retreat to make peace, where Skye's mother Jiaying kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Leader of the rival S.H.I.E.L.D., killed by Daisy's mother at the Retreat.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The daughter of Jiaying, the woman who kills Gonzales.

proposed.text: Skye is upset that Gonzales, not Coulson, comes to Afterlife to meet her mother Jiaying, who kills him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leader of the rival S.H.I.E.L.D., killed by Daisy's mother at Afterlife.

changes.evidence: Gonzales is killed at Afterlife, the Inhumans' haven. 'The Retreat' is the S.H.I.E.L.D. safe house where Skye stayed in S2#14-15, not the Inhumans' home. In S2#20 (Scars) Skye is upset to see Gonzales instead of Coulson at the meeting, and Jiaying kills him with a Terrigen crystal.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
now.text: Coulson talks a rampaging Cal down, helping him see that Jiaying is the true monster.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The director who talks Cal down.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Daisy's father, whom Coulson talks down.

changes.evidence: Coulson pinning Cal with the SUV and talking him down happens at the start of S.O.S. Part Two (S2#22). In Part One (S2#21) Coulson only questions Cal in his cell, and then Cal's completed serum makes him attack Coulson, Fitz and Simmons. Moving the stage keeps the ally kind and card lines; stage 3 is also at S2#22, so the owner may prefer to merge the two.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
now.text: At the Inhumans' Retreat, Raina's visions expose Jiaying's plans to Skye just before Jiaying kills her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman, whose visions expose Jiaying's plans to Daisy just before Jiaying kills Raina.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Inhuman, whom Raina's visions warn about Jiaying.

proposed.text: At Afterlife, Raina tells a doubtful Skye that Jiaying is misleading the Inhumans. Raina then provokes Jiaying into killing her where Skye can see, so that Skye learns the truth.

changes.evidence: In S2#21 (S.O.S. Part One) Raina tells an uncomprehending Skye that her destiny is to help Skye lead the Inhumans and that Jiaying is misleading them; Skye does not believe her. Raina then confronts Jiaying, who kills her, and Skye witnesses it as Raina intended. Her visions do not expose Jiaying's plans to Skye; her death does. It happens at Afterlife, not 'the Retreat' (a S.H.I.E.L.D. safe house).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
now.text: At the Inhumans' Retreat, Raina's visions expose Jiaying's plans to Skye just before Jiaying kills her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman, whose visions expose Jiaying's plans to Daisy just before Jiaying kills Raina.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Inhuman, whom Raina's visions warn about Jiaying.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman, whose death at Jiaying's hands shows Daisy the truth.

changes.evidence: Skye does not believe Raina's warning. What shows her the truth is seeing Jiaying kill Raina (S2#21). The b-card line ('whom Raina's visions warn about Jiaying') is true and stays.

owner_calls.question: The S2#20 stage is Kara helping Ward kidnap Hunter's ex-wife Bobbi. Kara and Hunter never deal with each other in that episode; Hunter only learns from footage in S2#21 that Kara took Bobbi. Should this stay as an indirect stage, or move to S2#21?
options: Keep as is (kidnapping his ex-wife is an act against Hunter)
Move to S2#21 with text: Hunter sees on footage that Kara, disguised as May, took Bobbi, and sets out to find her
Fold it into the S2#22 stage
owner_calls.evidence: Scars (S2#20): Kara ambushes Bobbi on a quinjet and Ward takes her, with no Hunter scene. S.O.S. Part One (S2#21): Hunter and Fitz review the footage and realize Bobbi went with Kara. Part Two (S2#22): Hunter and May's team trade fire with Kara and Ward.
